_meta.source_request: Founder refinement: anything enforceable or automatable must be enforced/automated; no new oya CLI surface.

description: Seed contract and initial rows for the Phase-0 automation ratchet. This file is not a green claim: it defines the required coverage model and initial founder-decided rows. The Phase-0 gate remains RED until every Phase-0 rule/ADR amendment/operating-contract requirement has a row and every automatable item maps to a Rust gate, cloud-ci controller, generated registry, or fixture-backed bridge with retirement criteria.

gate_contract.producer: GitHub Actions .github/workflows/presubmit.yml fan-in over Rust/Buck2 gate packets; owned ci runner only after explicit proven cutover
reds_when: any Phase-0 acceptance criterion, test, ADR amendment, operating-contract requirement, structural-lock/revert rule, pack-root classifier, generated registry, branch-protection constraint, or claim gate lacks a row
an automatable item is classified as not_automatable_human_judgment
a row maps a blocking invariant to an oya CLI invocation
a transitory bridge lacks deletion or cutover criteria

a merge-admission row requires pre-merge review authority but has no live trusted review-authority source with durable review evidence or a machine-verifiable review status that blocks merge, proves reviewer != author, and binds the reviewed PR title/body evidence

known_gaps_before_green: Required-context identity is CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE: dev requires exactly presubmit and a current origin/dev workflow run is green. This closes only context naming/cutover, not Phase-0.
Trusted-control-state and candidate-independent producer proof remains GAP: the candidate checkout can still influence workflow/gate definitions until a trusted controller catalog is proven.
Live dev protection has enforce_admins=false and required_signatures=false while the checked-in target requires true; drift reconciliation and enforcement remain GAP.
Pre-merge review authority remains GAP (F-PR5-06): required_pull_request_reviews is absent and no trusted reviewer!=author admission producer blocks merge.
non_negotiables: No new oya CLI commands or protected-branch authority are introduced by this matrix.
Operator procedure is a temporary defect unless classified as irreducible human judgment and backed by evidence, owner, and retirement path for automatable subparts.

Mechanically enforced requires the live presubmit context plus RED/GREEN fixtures or an equivalent controller-owned block and closure of trusted-producer/control-state gaps; context identity alone is insufficient.

seed_rows.requirement: Protected branch merge/exit authority is exactly the live presubmit context produced by GitHub Actions today; an owned ci runner may replace that producer only after explicit cutover proof. Candidate-independent trusted gate definitions remain required.
Prevent new oya CLI commands or legacy wrappers from becoming protected CI/merge authority; complete retirement of residual local surfaces remains tracked debt.

seed_rows.evidence_path: ADR-0515 current GitHub admission contract + future Tide admission evidence bundle
seed_rows.requirement: ADR-0515 retains GitHub protected-PR admission as current authority. Tide is a future/reference controller shape only; Phase 1 must prove projected-state, batching, and auto-rebase before any live ownership claim.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: future ci Tide admission controller (not live)

seed_rows.requirement: Pure split removes service-shaped sprawl but preserves ADR-0010/0064 pack roots until explicitly superseded.
Regulated readiness/enforcement/security/completion vocabulary must have live evidence or target/non-claim labeling.
Any performance, production-ready, or hyperscaler-grade claim must map to explicit SLI/budget/measurement evidence; advisory benchmarks cannot be authority.
seed_rows.retirement_phase: P0.7/AC-0.17 for claim blocking; Phase 1/2 for measured service budget gates
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: cloud-ci-claim-ceiling now; cloud-ci-performance-budget release-promotion gate as Phase-1/2 service evidence matures

seed_rows.requirement: Internal and customer tenant pipeline identities, secrets, runners, workspaces, caches, artifacts, logs/evidence, release ledgers, deploy targets, status callbacks, and audit events must be separated before any isolation/tenant-facing claim.

seed_rows.evidence_path: specs/fixtures/phase0-exit-gate/ + specs/phase0-automation-matrix.json + specs/phase0-claim-evidence-map.json + P0.0 evidence bundle
seed_rows.requirement: Phase 0 exit is a single aggregate gate over AC-0.0..0.17, fixture coverage, inventory, structural packets, generated registry, automation matrix, claim ceiling, and P0.0 required-context/tenant-isolation proof.
Every enforceable or automatable Phase-0 rule must map to a gate/controller/generated registry/fixture or an explicitly owned human-judgment exception with retirement path.

seed_rows.evidence_path: .github/branch-protection.yaml + infra/branch-protection/dev.json + registry/fixuptasks.jsonl#F-PR5-06 (target/live drift; review authority remains absent)
seed_rows.requirement: PR merge admission must include live durable review evidence or a machine-verifiable review status before merge, with reviewed PR title/body evidence bound to that status; green CI and target-only branch-protection text are not review authority.
